## RLM chat
- Long RLM tasks no longer look stopped: Claake now waits until Prime has really finished, including continuations after tool calls and background commands that finish later.
- Stop now also clears queued Prime work.
- Validated lessons are recalled on every RLM message, including in conversations that are already open.
- Goal mode now starts Prime's native goal with a 200,000-token budget; Ask and Plan add their instructions to the RLM message.
- Prime's session-local memory now works (Prime f24bccc): local and global memories stay separate and survive a kernel restart.

## Learning
- The lesson bench can now validate lessons on the real RLM engine, in an isolated Prime session that never touches your memories.

## Fixes
- Removed build warnings (unused ripgrep and edit helpers) and repaired two broken tests.

## Known limits
- Long RLM tasks and Goal mode have not yet been verified manually with a live model.
